app.name: Engine Console
palette.title: Command palette
auth.title: API key
auth.explain: The console needs an API key for this connection. The key stays in this tab's session storage and is cleared when the tab closes.
auth.required: The server rejected the request (401). Set a valid API key from the key button in the top bar.
auth.saved: API key saved for this session
dash.no_instances_hint: Launch a model to see live throughput and KV-cache usage here.
models.gated_tip: Requires accepting the licence on Hugging Face and an HF token.
models.gated_note: This model is gated: accept its licence on Hugging Face and make sure HF_TOKEN is set on the server, or the download will fail.
models.no_results_hint: Try a broader query or clear a filter.
models.fit_matrix: Fit per engine and GPU (default settings)
models.fit_hint: Each cell is a real estimate using default parameters on that single GPU. Open Launch to tune context and concurrency.
models.fit_unavailable: Fit estimates need at least one engine and one GPU.
models.local_empty_hint: Download a model from the Hugging Face tab.
models.confirm_delete: Remove {repo} from the local cache? It can be downloaded again.
fit.title: Memory fit
fit.empty: Choose a model and at least one GPU to see the estimated memory fit.
fit.est_tip: Weights-only estimate from file sizes. Open the model card or Launch for the full estimate.
fit.max_ctx: Max context at this concurrency: {n} tokens
dl.empty_hint: Start one above, or from the Models page.
launch.model_hint: Hugging Face repo ID. Downloaded models are suggested.
launch.name: Instance name
launch.blocked: This combination is blocked by a compatibility rule
launch.confirm_wont_fit: The estimate says this will not fit in memory. Launching will most likely fail. Launch anyway?
params.memory_tip: Changing this re-runs the memory fit estimate.
inst.name: Name
inst.empty_hint: Launch a model to create one.
inst.confirm_remove: Remove this instance? The container is deleted; the model stays cached.
inst.failed_generic: The instance failed. See the log for the last lines before the crash.
inst.ttl_prompt: Auto-stop after N idle minutes (0 = never)
metrics.no_instances_hint: Launch a model to chart its metrics.
metrics.no_data_hint: Metrics appear once the instance is ready and serving.
bench.empty_hint: Run one above; results are stored so you can compare across profiles.
chat.no_ready_hint: Start an instance from Launch, then come back.
chat.empty_hint: Messages stream from the selected instance. Attach images for vision models.
chat.placeholder: Message (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
chat.prompt_need: Enter a name and a system prompt first
arena.blind: Blind (hide model names until you vote)
arena.prompt_ph: Ask both models the same thing
arena.need_two_hint: Start two engines to compare them side by side.
arena.no_board_hint: Vote on a match to start the Elo leaderboard.
usage.empty_hint: Usage is recorded for every chat request through the console.
settings.language_hint: More languages can be added in i18n/.
settings.hf_token_hint: Set on the server via env or a 0600 file; the console never shows it.
settings.confirm_revoke: Revoke key {name}? Clients using it will get 401.
settings.key_once: Copy this key now. It is shown only once and stored hashed on the server.
settings.session_key_set: An API key is set for this tab.
settings.session_key_none: No API key set for this tab.
params.secret_ph: Secret: stored by name, never shown
launch.concurrency_hint: Parallel requests to size the KV cache for.
launch.preflight_unknown: Preflight reported a problem without details.
inst.last_logs: Last log lines before the failure
err.too_large: The request body was too large for the server.
err.unsupported_media: Unsupported content type: imports must be JSON or YAML.
err.bad_host: The server rejected the Host header. Open the console via 127.0.0.1 or localhost.
err.too_many_streams: Too many live streams are open, for this key or on the whole console. Close other console tabs and reload.
err.rate_limited: Too many requests. Wait a moment and retry.
params.redacted_ph: [set] on the server. Re-enter to change
launch.secrets_note: These fields were saved with secret values that the server never returns. Enter them again before launching: {keys}
launch.image_hint: Set by an administrator in Settings; it cannot be changed per instance.
settings.cache_dir_hint: Set at server start-up; it cannot be changed from the UI.
inst.secret_tip: A secret value: stored on the server, never shown.
err.not_managed: This engine was already running before the console started, so the console can only monitor it.
inst.external_tip: Started outside the console. It can be monitored, chatted with and (after confirmation) benchmarked, but not stopped, restarted, removed or pinned.
inst.not_managed_tip: Not controllable: this engine was started outside the console.
inst.reason_auth: The engine requires an API key, so the console cannot read its state or metrics. It is still listed.
inst.reason_unreach: The engine did not answer the last probe. It will be re-checked automatically.
inst.no_ext_logs: Logs are only available for engines started by the console.
inst.no_ext_cmd: No launch command: the console did not start this engine. Parameters shown are a best-effort read of its arguments, with secrets redacted.
metrics.no_metrics_ext: This engine does not expose a /metrics endpoint the console can read, so there is nothing to chart.
metrics.no_metrics_ext_hint: Engines such as Ollama do not publish Prometheus metrics. Chat and Benchmark still work.
metrics.auth_ext: The engine requires an API key, so its metrics cannot be read.
bench.confirm_external: This will send load to an engine the console doesn't own.
mem.unavailable_tip: Unavailable: the console could not read this engine's host memory.
mem.approx_tip: Approximate: read from process RSS because cgroup accounting was not available.
mem.shm_tip: Shared memory (tmpfs, CUDA host buffers, model weights mapped by engines) is not reclaimable: it counts as used even though it looks like cache.
metrics.no_host_ram: No host-RAM samples for this engine.
learn.no_term: No explanation is available for this term.
mode.manage_tip: The console may start, stop and change engines on this machine, within its policy.
mode.monitor_tip: Read-only: the console can watch this machine but not change anything.
mode.title: Policy mode
auth.rejected: The server rejected this key. Enter a valid key to continue.
auth.manager_hint: Your browser can remember the key: allow it to save the password when it asks.
fleet.disabled_text: This machine is turned off in the hosts file, so the console does not connect to it.
fleet.stale_for: No reading for {n} s: the numbers below are the last ones received.
fleet.unrestricted_short: Reached with an unrestricted SSH key.
fleet.unified_note: Unified memory: shares the machine's {total} of RAM (see the memory bar).
fleet.block_unknown: That machine is not known to the console.
fleet.block_stale: {host} has not reported for a while, so nothing can be changed until it answers again.
fleet.block_down: {host} is down: nothing can be changed there until the connection is back.
fleet.block_incompatible: {host} runs a node that does not match this console: update one of them.
fleet.block_disabled: {host} is turned off in the hosts file.
fleet.block_monitor: {host} is in monitor mode: the console can look but not change anything. Its administrator switches it to manage mode in the node policy.
err.network: Cannot reach the console backend. Check that it is running and that you opened this page from its own address.
err.csrf: The request was blocked by the cross-site protection (the X-Engine-Console header is missing). Reload the page and try again.
err.cross_origin: The request came from another origin. Open the console at its own address instead of through another site.
err.node_unavailable: That machine is not connected right now, so nothing can be done there until its link is up.
err.busy: That machine is busy with another operation. Wait for it to finish and try again.
err.monitor_only: That machine is in monitor mode: the console can look but not change anything. Its administrator can switch the node policy to manage mode.
err.policy_denied: That machine's policy does not allow this. An administrator on that machine can change its policy file if you want to permit it.
err.not_owned: That container was not created by the console, so the console will not touch it.
err.in_use: That is in use by a running engine. Stop the engine first.
err.port_in_use: No free network port was available for the engine. Stop an engine you do not need and try again.
err.conflict: That conflicts with the current state.
err.no_space: There is not enough free space on that drive. Free some space or choose another folder.
err.timeout: The machine did not answer in time. The action may or may not have happened: check before trying again.
err.unsupported: That machine or engine does not support this action.
err.integrity: A downloaded file failed its integrity check. Try the download again.
err.node_failed: The machine reported a failure while doing that.
err.unknown_host: That machine is not in the console's hosts file.
err.egress: The egress proxy is not available, so the console cannot reach Hugging Face right now.
err.model_missing: The model is not on that machine. Download it there or copy it from the Library first.
err.format_unsupported: That engine cannot load this kind of model file. Choose an engine that supports it.
err.unauthorized: The server rejected the API key. Use the key button in the top bar to enter a valid one.
err.forbidden: Your key's role does not allow this. A viewer key is read-only; use an admin key.
err.not_found: That no longer exists. Reload the page.
err.conflict_state: That conflicts with the current state. Reload the page and try again.
err.unavailable: The service or that machine is unavailable right now. Try again in a moment.
discover.admin_only: Searching Hugging Face needs an admin key
discover.admin_only_hint: Searches and model cards use the operator's Hugging Face token, so a viewer key cannot run them. The models already on your machines are in the Library.
discover.fit_hint: Each cell is a real estimate with default settings, using all of that machine's GPUs. Open Launch to tune context and users.
dl.dialog_intro: Choose the machine that should store this model, and the folder on it. The download runs through this console, which checks every file before the machine accepts it.
dl.dialog_intro_gguf: This repository offers several quantizations of the same model. Pick one, then the machine and folder to store it on.
dl.dialog_no_space: Not enough free space in that folder.
dl.dialog_fit_tight: Would be a tight fit in {host}'s GPU memory.
dl.dialog_fit_wont_fit: Would not fit in {host}'s GPU memory (it could still be stored there).
dl.repo_hint: A Hugging Face repository such as org/model-name.
picker.no_root_hint: {host} has no writable folder of the right kind in its policy, so nothing can be stored there.
picker.no_machine: No machine can take files right now: every machine is down, read-only or disabled.
picker.root_failed: Could not read this machine's folders
host.link_up_text: The console is connected and receiving fresh readings from this machine.
host.unrestricted_text: This machine was reached with an SSH key that is not limited to the console's node command, so a stolen key could do more than start the node. An administrator should restrict the key on that machine to the node command.
host.no_data: No readings are available from this machine yet. Details appear once the connection is up.
host.rootful_text: On this machine, being allowed to start containers is close to being an administrator, so anyone who can drive the console can do more here than on a rootless setup. Consider rootless Docker.
host.no_policy: This machine has not reported its policy yet.
host.mode_manage_text: The console may start, stop and change engines here and write model files, but only inside the limits below: the images, folders and switches this machine's own policy allows.
host.mode_monitor_text: Read-only. The console can show this machine's hardware, engines and models, and you can chat with and benchmark its engines, but the console cannot start, stop or change anything or write files.
host.howto_title: How to switch to manage mode:
host.howto_text: On that machine, an administrator edits {path}, sets "mode" to "manage" and restarts the node. The console can read the policy but can never change it.
host.policy_readonly: This policy lives in {path} on that machine. Only its administrator can change it; the console can only read it.
host.policy_error: The node could not use its policy file ({error}), so it runs in monitor mode until that is fixed.
host.p_pull_help: Whether the console may download engine images onto this machine.
host.p_delete_help: Whether the console may delete model files here.
host.p_ipc_help: Whether engines may use the machine's shared inter-process memory (needed by some multi-GPU setups).
host.p_external_none_help: The console can list them, chat with them and benchmark them, but not stop or start them.
host.p_external_stop_start_help: The console may stop and start such an engine, but never change or remove it.
host.no_procs: No program is using this GPU.
host.unified_text: This machine has unified memory: the GPU and the system share one pool, so engines and the system compete for the same space.
host.no_roots: This machine's policy lists no model folders.
host.no_images: No engine images are on this machine.
host.scripts_intro: These are start and stop scripts this machine's administrator registered. The console runs them as written and never works around them.
host.no_scripts: No scripts are registered for this machine.
inst.no_script_logs: Logs are not available for script-run engines: the script owns the container. Use the script's own tools, or check its status above.
inst.confirm_script: This runs the script's own {action} action ({script}). It may stop other engines that depend on it. Continue?
inst.confirm_external: {name} was not started by the console. {action}? Whatever depends on it will lose it.
controls.reason_managed: This control is not available right now.
controls.reason_script: This engine is started and stopped by the script {script} on {host}; its buttons run the script's actions.
controls.reason_external: This engine was started outside the console and the machine's policy does not let the console stop or start it. Use Clone as managed to run your own copy.
engines.no_images_allowed: {host}'s policy allows no engine images, so nothing can be started there.
engines.image_not_allowed: {host}'s policy does not allow the {engine} image.
launch.checks_hint: Run the checks to see what the machine will say before anything starts.
launch.model_hint_v2: Models this machine can read, grouped by format.
launch.model_hint_none: This machine has no models yet. Copy one from the Library, download one from Discover, or enter a Hugging Face repository below.
launch.image_hint_v2: The default is the image pinned for this machine. Only images its policy allows (and that are present) can be chosen.
learn.empty_hint: The learn content could not be loaded. Reload the page, or check that the console is up to date.
library.summary: {models} models · {copies} copies · {size} on disk in total
library.empty: No models found on any machine
library.empty_hint: Download a model from Discover, or check that each machine's policy lists its model folders.
library.no_match_hint: Clear a filter or change the search.
library.quant_tip: Quantization: how compactly the weights are stored.
library.no_engine_tip: None of the console's engines loads this kind of file.
library.offline_tip: That machine is not connected, so this is its last-known list.
library.launch_pick_intro: {name} can be read by several machines. Choose where to run it.
library.cannot_launch: This machine cannot load that copy.
library.copy_intro: Copy {name} from {host} to another machine. The files stream through this console and are checked on arrival.
library.confirm_delete: Delete {name} from {host}? This removes the files at {path}. They can be downloaded again.
library.reason_in_use: In use by {names}. Stop it first.
library.reason_read_only: This folder is read-only, so files in it cannot be deleted.
library.reason_policy_delete: {host}'s policy does not allow deleting models.
library.reason_not_deletable: The machine says this copy cannot be deleted.
library.reason_no_copy: {host} cannot read this model. Copy it there first.
library.reason_everywhere: Every machine can already read this copy.
library.reason_no_target_manage: No other machine can take files: they are down or in monitor mode.
settings.beginner_hint: Beginner mode is on by default. It keeps the console easy to use if you have never run an inference engine.
settings.beginner_1: Each setting's one-line explanation is shown right under its label.
settings.beginner_2: The launch form starts with the basic settings only; advanced and expert ones are one click away.
settings.beginner_3: Launch opens the guided wizard: model, machine, goal, review.
settings.pins_none_hint: Machines appear here once they are connected and have reported their policy.
settings.pin_image: Image to use on this machine
settings.pins_hint: Leave a field empty to use the default. {host}'s own policy decides which images are allowed; the console refuses others.
wizard.title: Launch wizard
wizard.step_model_intro: Pick the model you want to run. Models stored on your machines are listed with how much memory they need.
wizard.step_machine_intro: Each machine is checked: will the model fit in its memory, and why or why not?
wizard.step_goal_intro: Say what you will use it for. The console picks the settings that suit that goal.
wizard.step_review_intro: Check what will happen. Every setting that differs from the engine's default is listed with an explanation.
wizard.no_models_hint: Download a model from Discover first, then come back.
wizard.fits_nowhere: Probably does not fit on any of your machines.
wizard.no_engine_for_format: None of the console's engines can load this kind of model file.
wizard.no_engine_here: No engine on this machine is allowed to run this kind of model.
wizard.gpu_unified: Unified memory: the GPU shares the machine's {total} of RAM
wizard.wont_fit_reason: Choose a smaller model, or a machine with more memory.
wizard.copy_there: Copy it there from the Library
wizard.reason_fits: Needs about {need} GiB per GPU out of {have} GiB available ({pct}%).
wizard.reason_tight: Needs about {need} GiB per GPU out of {have} GiB available ({pct}%): it may fail with long conversations or several users.
wizard.reason_wont: Needs about {need} GiB per GPU but only {have} GiB is available.
wizard.reason_wont_tp: Needs about {need} GiB per GPU, more than one card holds. It needs {n} GPUs together.
wizard.reason_unknown: The console could not estimate this one.
wizard.change_engine_hint: Only engines that can load this model and that the machine may run are listed.
wizard.review_settings: Settings that differ from the defaults
wizard.review_settings_intro: These are the only settings the console will change. Everything else stays at the engine's default.
wizard.review_no_changes: Every setting stays at the engine's default.
wizard.review_name_hint: Optional. A short label so you can recognise it in the list.
goal.low-latency.title: One person chatting
goal.low-latency.hint: Quick replies for you alone, with a moderate amount of text per conversation.
goal.balanced.title: General use
goal.balanced.hint: A sensible middle: good for a few people and everyday questions.
goal.max-throughput.title: Many users at once
goal.max-throughput.hint: Serve as many people as possible at the same time; each reply may take a little longer.
goal.long-context.title: Long documents
goal.long-context.hint: Read and discuss very long texts, such as whole reports or code bases.
goal.tool-agent.title: Coding agent or tools
goal.tool-agent.hint: For assistants that call tools or edit code: tool calling on, with a long memory.
check.secret_in_argv: Secrets kept off the command line
inst.available_hint: Stopped engines you can start. They hold no GPU memory until you do.
inst.none_running_hint: Everything listed below is stopped. Start one, or launch a model.
inst.none_running_here: No engine is running on this machine.
fleet.stale_last: The numbers below are the last ones received.
picker.blocked_summary_one: {count} machine cannot take files right now
picker.blocked_summary_other: {count} machines cannot take files right now

goal.big-model-offload.title: Big model, small GPU
goal.moe-experts-on-cpu.title: Big mixture-of-experts model
goal.low-memory.title: Save memory
goal.many-models.title: Many models, one server
